links.comparator_used: Default prompt with no reading-level or audience instruction (no-prompt condition), alongside patient-friendly and references prompts
links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of chatbot responses to patient education questions on aesthetic facial plastic surgery
links.effect: With eighth-grade prompting, mean grade level was ChatGPT 10.5 ± 1.8 and Google Bard 9.6 ± 1.3, still above the eighth-grade target; Google Bard was at a significantly lower grade level than ChatGPT for all prompts (p < 0.05). The abstract gives no numbers for the no-prompt baseline.
links.quote: Despite eighth-grade prompting, response grade level for both chatbots was high: ChatGPT (10.5 ± 1.8) and Google Bard™ (9.6 ± 1.3).
